description: This PHP class 'PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams' extends a base filter parameters class and provides properties and methods for handling search filter parameters specific to PimDefinedReports, such as 'name' and 'reportId'. It also defines allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for defining search filter parameters specific to PimDefinedReports, including filters for name and report ID, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'report.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'reportId' filter parameter.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'reportId' filter parameter.
